end.summary: Identified visitor harm: litter, noise, feeding animals, touching coral, collecting, and damaging plants or walls.
end.parentNote: Tara practised spotting harmful visitor actions and suggesting responsible choices such as carrying waste back, staying off coral, and not collecting plants, flowers, or stones. They used picture clues and examples to explain several effects, including animals becoming dependent on visitor food. Tara still mixed up feeding wild animals with helping them; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Tara to sort actions into “protects a place” and “harms a place,” especially feeding animals and leaving rubbish.
